testCases: ungraded free base heals one B with zero mana and no caster record; no XP or stored healing
bounded augmentation pays actual mana once and heals L/A at 4/10 points
odd augmentation floors healing points and unused points never accumulate across save round trips
augmentation above actual cap, fractional choices, or absent caster input reject before payment
actual owned version, conjuration qualification and bound magic pool are required
touch, living type, actual death, components and allocation are checked before payment
actual wound restrictions survive healing and JSON save roundtrip
combat kit dispatch pays one standard and rejects a second cast without changing original state
self treatment needs living wounds and qualifications but no external touch distance
